description: Book a clinic appointment by phone. The caller wants a specific patient, day, and time, and the agent may only book a slot the calendar still has open.

tools.name: list_slots
tools.description: List open appointment slots on a given date.

clinic.description: Clinic name. Use downtown if the caller does not name one.

tools.name: book_slot
tools.description: Book an open slot for a named patient.

constraints: Collect patient name, date, and time before booking.
Call list_slots before book_slot and only offer times the tool returned.
Call book_slot only after the caller explicitly confirms the patient name, date, and time.
If the caller changes a detail, use the corrected value and confirm again.
success_criteria: The booked slot matches the confirmed patient, date, and time.
book_slot is not called when confirmation is missing or the slot was not listed.
